name: Halibut
siboNotes: Naturally FODMAP-free and excellent for SIBO diets. Avoid breading or FODMAP-containing marinades and seasonings.
preparationTips: Season with FODMAP-friendly herbs like basil, oregano, or thyme
Use garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic for flavor
Grill, bake, or pan-sear with olive oil and lemon
Pair with low FODMAP vegetables for complete meals
nutritionalHighlights: High in lean protein (40g per 200g serving)
Excellent source of selenium and magnesium
Good source of vitamin B12 and niacin
